sql: select (select max(started_at)::text from bot_runs) as last_cycle, (select count(*) from mmsell_candidate_ticks where captured_at > now() - interval '10 minutes') as cands_10m, (select count(*) from paper_trades where created_at > now() - interval '10 minutes') as paper_10m, (select count(*) from paper_trades where strategy='Dmmsell10_pt4') as twin_rows, (select count(*) from live_orders where strategy='Dmmsell10') as dmmsell10_orders, (select count(*) from live_orders where strategy='Dmmsell10' and status='filled') as dmmsell10_filled, now()::text as now_utc
